name: Rugby football is said to have been created
description: Rugby football is said to have been created in 1823 when William Webb Ellis, a student at Rugby School in England, picked up the ball and ran with it during a game of soccer.

name: First rugby match
description: The first recorded rugby football match took place in 1843 between Rugby School and the town of Rugby.

name: Formation of the Rugby Football Union (RFU)
description: The Rugby Football Union (RFU) was formed in 1871 as the governing body for rugby football in England.

name: Introduction of the first international rugby match
description: The first international rugby match took place in 1871 between England and Scotland.

name: Formation of the first rugby league
description: The first rugby league was formed in 1895 after the Northern Rugby Football Union (NRFU) broke away from the RFU due to disagreements over compensation for players.

name: Formation of the International Rugby Board (IRB)
description: The International Rugby Board (now World Rugby) was formed in 1886 as the international governing body for rugby football.

name: Introduction of the Five Nations Championship
description: The Five Nations Championship (now known as the Six Nations Championship) was introduced in 1883 as an annual rugby union competition between England, Ireland, Scotland, Wales, and later France.

name: Rugby included in the Olympic Games
description: Rugby union was included in the Olympic Games in 1900 and 1908, before being removed and then reintroduced in 2016.

name: Formation of the New Zealand Rugby Football Union (NZRFU)
description: The New Zealand Rugby Football Union (now New Zealand Rugby) was formed in 1892 as the governing body for rugby union in New Zealand.

name: Invention of the penalty kick
description: The penalty kick was officially introduced to rugby union in 1891 as a method of scoring points.

name: Introduction of the Rugby World Cup
description: The first Rugby World Cup took place in 1987, hosted by New Zealand and Australia. The tournament is now held every four years.

name: Formation of the Australian Rugby Union (ARU)
description: The Australian Rugby Union (now Rugby Australia) was formed in 1949 as the governing body for rugby union in Australia.

name: Formation of the South African Rugby Union (SARU)
description: The South African Rugby Union (now known as SA Rugby) was formed in 1889 as the governing body for rugby union in South Africa.

name: Introduction of the Rugby Championship
description: The Rugby Championship (formerly known as the Tri Nations) was introduced in 1996 as an annual rugby union competition between Australia, New Zealand, and South Africa.

name: Formation of the Irish Rugby Football Union (IRFU)
description: The Irish Rugby Football Union (IRFU) was formed in 1879 as the governing body for rugby union in Ireland.

name: Introduction of rugby sevens
description: Rugby sevens, a variant of rugby union with only seven players per team, was introduced in 1883.

name: Invention of the drop goal
description: The drop goal, a method of scoring points by dropping the ball and kicking it as it bounces off the ground, was introduced to rugby union in 1886.

name: Formation of the Argentina Rugby Union (UAR)
description: The Argentina Rugby Union (now known as the Argentine Rugby Union) was formed in 1899 as the governing body for rugby union in Argentina.

name: Introduction of rugby league in Australia
description: Rugby league was introduced in Australia in 1908 with the formation of the New South Wales Rugby League (NSWRL).

name: Formation of the World Rugby Sevens Series
description: The World Rugby Sevens Series, a series of international rugby sevens tournaments, was formed in 1999.

name: Introduction of the British and Irish Lions
description: The British and Irish Lions, a team made up of players from England, Ireland, Scotland, and Wales, played their first tour in 1888.

name: Introduction of the Women's Rugby World Cup
description: The first Women's Rugby World Cup took place in 1991, hosted by Wales. The tournament is now held every four years.
